text:
maria: FYI PR #6247 is blocked on the design/RFC — need arch review before we can merge. Short summary: change routing fallback to prefer lower-cost compatible model within the same region before doing cross-region fallback. Impacts routing order and observability metrics. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/6247 RFC: https://redwood-inference.atlassian.net/browse/RFC-089 @arch-team
eli: @maria can you paste a one-line behavioral diff here so reviewers don’t have to open both links?
maria: one-liner: prefer cheaper compatible variant in-region before cross-region fallback; add opt-out flag to preserve reserved capacity semantics. I’ll update the RFC with an SLO/impact table and test plan.
sam: pinging @nina and @nate-ops for perf and dedicated-capacity concerns :eyes:
nina: quick skim — two asks: (1) include explicit latency SLOs and expected p95 delta; (2) ensure dedicated/reserved pools are never bypassed unless explicitly configured. Suggest a config flag like `respect_reserved_pools: true`.
maria: good catches. will add `respect_reserved_pools: true` default and a config opt-out, plus an SLO table.
nate-ops: +1 to nina. also please add a canary plan: region A -> 10% traffic -> monitor cost + errors for 72h. include smoke test steps to validate KV cache behavior.
maria: will add canary plan + smoke tests to RFC and PR. PR is blocked until I push that update — ETA EOD today.
nina: once the RFC has the SLO table and runbook steps I can give LGTM on the design. also include rollback criteria in the runbook.
eli: small nit left on the PR: inline comment suggesting rename `fallback_priority` -> `fallback_order` for clarity. not blocking.
maria: fixed that rename in the latest push, thanks.
deploy-bot: CI: All checks passed :white_check_mark:
nate-ops: thanks all. @maria after the RFC patch and test matrix I’ll review and approve the PR from ops side.
maria: will push updates shortly and ping this thread once done :thumbsup:
